provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations
capability: host-provisioned Gateway/Ingress controller and loopback TLS listener

cases.expected: Controller/listener ownership is separated from the application route and backend.

cases.task: Inspect host,path prefix,parent and backend port.

cases.expected: Current parent-specific conditions support configuration acceptance,not final delivery alone.

cases.task: Use the qualified loopback client for /version and an unmatched path.
cases.expected: Expected version response on the match;documented no-route result on the negative path.

cases.task: Use the host-provided CA/hostname and test a mismatched identity.
cases.expected: Valid chain/hostname succeeds;wrong identity fails without an insecure bypass.

cases.task: Review the separate Ingress fixture and name what is independently required.
cases.expected: Qualified ingressClass/controller plus exact route cleanup;no assumption of API interchangeability.
